title: Application to Study Permit Process Steps for Denmark
notice: 1 DKK ≈ 13.5 BDT. Study permit processing takes 3–5 months — apply as soon as you receive your admission letter. SIRI handles all study permits for Denmark.

processSteps.label: University Application : via individual university portals (DTU, Copenhagen, Aarhus, CBS etc.)
bullets: Most English-taught programs: apply directly to university website
Deadlines typically March–April for September intake

processSteps.label: Offer / Admission Letter
bullets: Non-EU/EEA students: tuition fees 45,000–120,000 DKK/year (6,07,000–16,20,000 BDT)
Check if your program or university offers a merit scholarship or tuition waiver

processSteps.label: Arrange Proof of Funds : 74,916 DKK in bank account
bullets: Bank statement showing 74,916 DKK (6,243 DKK/month for one year) — must be in your name
Scholarship or stipend confirmation also accepted in lieu of bank funds

processSteps.label: Arrange Accommodation : Student housing or rental agreement confirmation
bullets: Apply for student housing immediately after admission — Copenhagen waiting lists are long
Student housing: 3,000–5,500 DKK/month; private: 7,000–12,000 DKK/month in Copenhagen

processSteps.label: SIRI Study Permit Application (online) : 2,205 DKK
bullets: Apply at newtodenmark.dk — upload admission letter, bank statement, passport, accommodation proof
Processing: 3–5 months — apply as soon as you receive your admission letter

processSteps.label: VFS Global Dhaka Biometrics Appointment
bullets: Book appointment at vfsglobal.com well in advance
Bring original passport, SIRI reference number, and photo

costSteps.label: SIRI Study Permit Fee : 2,205 DKK (~29,770 BDT) — paid online at newtodenmark.dk
VFS Global Dhaka Service Fee : check vfsglobal.com for current rate
Tuition Fee : 45,000–120,000 DKK/year (6,07,000–16,20,000 BDT) — program dependent
Proof of Funds (bank statement) : 74,916 DKK (~10,11,000 BDT) — stays in your account
